commands.step: Runtime dependency list must stay empty
commands.text:
python - <<'PY'
import tomllib, sys
deps = tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project'].get('dependencies', [])
if deps:
    print(f"::error::fx-dub declares runtime dependencies: {deps}. "
          "SECURITY.md promises none. Update both, deliberately, or drop the dep.")
    sys.exit(1)
print("runtime dependencies: none, as documented")
PY

TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
VER=$(python -c "import tomllib;print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version'])")
echo "tag=$TAG manifest=$VER"
test "$TAG" = "$VER" || { echo "::error::tag $TAG != pyproject version $VER"; exit 1; }
